question_gu: જો f(x)=1 માટે 0<x<π અને f(x)=0 માટે −π<x<0 હોય, તો x=0 પર corresponding Fourier seriesનું મૂલ્ય શું છે?
explanation_en: The official corrected key is C. Under the standard convergence convention at a jump, the Fourier series equals the average of the one-sided limits, 1/2; therefore the source item is flagged while preserving the official key.
explanation_gu: Official corrected key C છે. Standard jump-convergence convention મુજબ value 1/2 આવે છે; તેથી official key preserve કરીને review flag રાખ્યો છે.
review_note: Official key C conflicts with the usual jump-limit value 1/2; preserve key and review.
tip_en: At a jump, normally use the average of one-sided limits.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: If A = (1/3)i + μj is a unit vector, then the value of μ can be:
question_gu: જો A=(1/3)i + μj unit vector હોય, તો μનું મૂલ્ય શું હોઈ શકે?
explanation_en: For a unit vector, 1/9+μ²=1, so μ=±2√2/3. The negative value is option B, so the official key is consistent.
explanation_gu: Unit vector માટે 1/9+μ²=1, એટલે μ=±2√2/3. Negative value option B છે, એટલે official key consistent છે.
tip_en: Unit vector: sum of squares of components = 1.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: What is the value of ∭ ∇·F dxdydz over the region x²+y²+z²≤16, where F=(x²+y²+z²)(xi+yj+zk)?
question_gu: x²+y²+z²≤16 regionમાં F=(x²+y²+z²)(xi+yj+zk) માટે ∭∇·F dxdydzનું મૂલ્ય શું છે?
explanation_en: For the field as printed, direct divergence/integration does not reproduce the listed options. The official corrected key is D, so D is preserved and the item is flagged for source review.
explanation_gu: Printed field માટે direct divergence/integration options સાથે match થતું નથી. Official corrected key D છે, તેથી D preserve કરીને review flag રાખ્યો છે.
review_note: Official key D does not reproduce from a straightforward evaluation of the printed field/domain; preserve key.
tip_en: Use the divergence theorem and verify the printed vector-field expression.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: If a coin is tossed 5 times in succession, the probability of getting at least one head is:
question_gu: Coinને 5 વખત toss કરતાં ઓછામાં ઓછો એક head આવવાની probability કેટલી?
explanation_en: P(at least one head)=1−P(no heads)=1−(1/2)^5=31/32.
explanation_gu: P(at least one head)=1−(1/2)^5=31/32.
tip_en: At least one = 1 − none.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Hermite functions are useful in the study of:
question_gu: Hermite functionsનો ઉપયોગ કયા અભ્યાસમાં થાય છે?

options.A: Electrostatic problems involving multipolar charge distribution
options.C: Linear Harmonic Oscillator in quantum mechanics
options.D: Periodic potential problem in crystallinity of solids

explanation_en: Hermite polynomials/functions occur in the eigenfunctions of the one-dimensional quantum harmonic oscillator.
explanation_gu: Quantum harmonic oscillatorની eigenfunctionsમાં Hermite polynomials/functions આવે છે.
tip_en: Harmonic oscillator → Hermite polynomials.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Two circular discs D1 and D2 of same thickness and same mass have different densities, ρ1 and ρ2. If ρ1 > ρ2, they are rotated about an axis passing through centre and perpendicular to the discs.
question_gu: સમાન mass અને thicknessમાં higher density એટલે smaller volume અને radius. Disc માટે I=MR²/2 હોવાથી D1નું moment of inertia ઓછું.

options.A: They have same moment of inertia
options.B: Moment of inertia of D1 > Moment of inertia of D2
options.C: Moment of inertia of D1 < Moment of inertia of D2

explanation_en: Equal mass and thickness with higher density means smaller volume and hence smaller radius. Since I=MR²/2 for a disc, D1 has smaller moment of inertia.
explanation_gu: Higher density at fixed mass means smaller radius.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: In the theory of small oscillations, generally the dependency of potential energy on the displacement of a particle from equilibrium position is:
question_gu: Stable equilibrium પાસે linear term vanish થાય છે અને leading term quadratic હોય છે: V≈V0+½kx².
explanation_en: Near stable equilibrium, the first derivative of potential energy vanishes and the leading term is quadratic: V≈V0+(1/2)kx².
explanation_gu: Small oscillation → quadratic potential.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The unit of Hamiltonian is the unit of:
question_gu: Hamiltonian energyનું quantity છે. Optionsમાં torqueનું unit N·m છે, જે joule સાથે dimensionally equivalent છે.
explanation_en: The Hamiltonian has dimensions of energy. Among the listed choices, torque has the same SI dimensions N·m as joule.
explanation_gu: Hamiltonian has dimensions of energy.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A pendulum bob of mass m is held taut in a horizontal position and then released. What is the tension in the string when the bob reaches its lowest position?
question_gu: Bob L ઊંચાઈથી પડે છે તેથી v²=2gL. Lowest point પર T−mg=mv²/L=2mg, એટલે T=3mg.
explanation_en: The bob falls through height L, so v²=2gL. At the lowest point, T−mg=mv²/L=2mg, giving T=3mg.
explanation_gu: Released horizontal pendulum: bottom tension = 3mg.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Reduced mass of a two body system depends on:
question_gu: Reduced mass μ=m1m2/(m1+m2) છે અને R કે r પર depend કરતી નથી.

options.A: Position of the centre of mass R
options.D: Neither on R nor on r

explanation_en: The reduced mass is μ=m1m2/(m1+m2), depending only on the two masses, not on coordinates R or r.
explanation_gu: Reduced mass depends only on the two masses.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Electric field variation for a uniformly charged sphere of radius R with constant charge density ρ is:
question_gu: Constant charge density ρ ધરાવતા radius Rના uniformly charged sphere માટે electric field કેવી રીતે vary થાય છે?
explanation_en: Inside a uniformly charged sphere, Gauss law gives E(4πr²)=ρ(4πr³/3)/ε0, hence E=ρr/(3ε0), so E∝r.
explanation_gu: Uniform sphereની અંદર Gauss lawથી E=ρr/(3ε0), એટલે E∝r.
tip_en: Inside uniformly charged sphere: E∝r.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following is false?
question_gu: નીચેનામાંથી કયું statement false છે?

options.A: An electron moving from point A to B in a straight line at uniform speed radiates
options.B: Proton moving in linear accelerator radiates
options.C: Proton moving in a circular orbit at constant speed radiates
options.D: Electron while moving through a potential difference of 2500 volts in a straight line radiates

explanation_en: Uniform straight-line motion has zero acceleration, so it does not radiate classically. The official key marks A.
explanation_gu: Uniform straight-line motionમાં acceleration zero છે, તેથી classical radiation થતું નથી. Official key A છે.
tip_en: Radiation is associated with accelerated charge.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following equations relating to electric field E and magnetic field B rules out the possibility of an isolated magnetic monopole?
question_gu: Electric field E અને magnetic field B સંબંધિત કયું equation isolated magnetic monopoleની possibility rule out કરે છે?
explanation_en: Gauss law for magnetism is ∇·B=0, which states that magnetic field has no isolated source or sink in classical Maxwell theory.
explanation_gu: Magnetism માટે Gauss law ∇·B=0 છે, એટલે classical Maxwell theoryમાં isolated magnetic monopole નથી.
tip_en: No magnetic monopoles → ∇·B=0.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A battery of EMF ε and internal resistance r is connected to variable load resistance R. The maximum power delivered to load resistance R is obtained by varying R. The battery loses the energy at the rate of:
question_gu: EMF ε અને internal resistance r ધરાવતી battery variable load R સાથે જોડાય છે. R=r પર maximum power મળે છે. Battery energy કયા rateથી lose કરે છે?
explanation_en: At maximum power R=r, the current is I=ε/(2r). The internal loss is I²r=ε²/(4r). The official key is C, so the source item/key convention should be reviewed because the direct internal-loss calculation gives option A.
explanation_gu: Maximum power માટે R=r અને I=ε/(2r). Internal loss I²r=ε²/(4r) મળે છે. Official key C છે, એટલે source/key discrepancy માટે review જરૂરી છે.
tip_en: Maximum power theorem: R=r; then calculate current and internal loss.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A charged capacitor C is connected in series with an inductor L. When the displacement current is zero, the energy of LC circuit is:
question_gu: Charged capacitor C ને inductor L સાથે seriesમાં જોડવામાં આવે છે. Displacement current zero હોય ત્યારે LC circuitની energy શું છે?

options.A: stored entirely in its electric field
options.B: distributed equally among its electric and magnetic fields
options.D: stored entirely in its magnetic field

explanation_en: When current is zero, magnetic energy (1/2)LI² is zero. Therefore the conserved total energy is entirely electric, (1/2)CV².
explanation_gu: Current zero હોય ત્યારે magnetic energy zero છે. તેથી total conserved energy સંપૂર્ણ electric fieldમાં stored છે.
tip_en: At I=0, magnetic energy is zero.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The uncertainty relation applies to:
question_gu: Uncertainty relation કયા variables માટે લાગુ પડે છે?

options.C: A pair of dynamical variables which do not commute
options.D: A pair of dynamical variables which commute

explanation_en: The generalized uncertainty relation is ΔAΔB≥(1/2)|⟨[A,B]⟩|. Non-commuting observables give a nonzero lower bound in general.
explanation_gu: Generalized uncertainty relation ΔAΔB≥½|⟨[A,B]⟩| છે. Non-commuting observables માટે nonzero lower bound મળે છે.
tip_en: Uncertainty is tied to non-commutation.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Zero point energy of a three-dimensional harmonic oscillator in quantum mechanics is:
question_gu: Quantum mechanicsમાં three-dimensional harmonic oscillatorની zero-point energy કેટલી?
explanation_en: For a 3-D isotropic harmonic oscillator, the ground-state energy is 3ℏω/2.
explanation_gu: 3-D isotropic oscillator માટે ground-state energy 3ℏω/2 છે.
review_note: The scanned option lettering/formula is visually ambiguous; official key is preserved.
tip_en: 3-D zero-point energy = 3ℏω/2.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The magnitude of orbital angular momentum with quantum number l is:
question_gu: Orbital angular momentum માટે quantum number l હોય તો magnitude શું છે?
explanation_en: Since L² has eigenvalue l(l+1)ℏ², the magnitude is √[l(l+1)]ℏ.
explanation_gu: L²નું eigenvalue l(l+1)ℏ² છે, તેથી |L|=√[l(l+1)]ℏ.
tip_en: L²=l(l+1)ℏ².
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The dimension of wave function ψ in three-dimensional space is:
question_gu: Three-dimensional spaceમાં wave function ψનું dimension શું છે?
explanation_en: Normalization ∫|ψ|²d³r=1 requires |ψ|² to have dimension L^−3, hence ψ has dimension L^−3/2.
explanation_gu: Normalization ∫|ψ|²d³r=1 હોવાથી ψનું dimension L^−3/2 થાય છે.
tip_en: In 3-D, ψ has dimension L^−3/2.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The degeneracy of a level with principal quantum number n in a Hydrogen atom is:
question_gu: Hydrogen atomમાં principal quantum number n ધરાવતા levelની degeneracy કેટલી?
explanation_en: Including electron spin, the nth hydrogen level has degeneracy 2n²; without spin it is n².
explanation_gu: Electron spin સહિત degeneracy 2n² છે; spin વગર n² છે.
tip_en: Hydrogen degeneracy = 2n² including spin.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following is not an example of second order phase transition?
question_gu: નીચેનામાંથી કયું second-order phase transitionનું example નથી?

options.D: Superconducting state to normal state transition at Tc

explanation_en: Melting of ice to water is a first-order phase transition, whereas the other listed examples are associated with continuous/second-order transitions in the standard treatment.
explanation_gu: Iceનું waterમાં melting first-order phase transition છે; બાકીના examples standard treatmentમાં continuous/second-order transitions સાથે જોડાય છે.
tip_en: Melting is first-order; superconducting transition is second-order.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: In a Brownian motion, if D is diffusivity of Brownian particles and τ is diffusion time, then the dimension of Dτ is:
question_gu: Brownian motionમાં D diffusivity અને τ diffusion time હોય તો Dτનું dimension શું છે?
explanation_en: Diffusivity has dimension L²/T. Multiplying by time gives L², so Dτ has dimension M⁰L²T⁰.
explanation_gu: Diffusivityનું dimension L²/T છે. τથી multiply કરતાં Dτનું dimension L² એટલે M⁰L²T⁰ થાય છે.
tip_en: Diffusion coefficient D → L²/T.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Superfluidity is a phenomenon connected to:
question_gu: Superfluidity કયા phenomenon સાથે connected છે?
explanation_en: Superfluidity is closely associated with Bose-Einstein condensation and macroscopic quantum coherence in bosonic systems.
explanation_gu: Superfluidity Bose-Einstein condensation અને macroscopic quantum coherence સાથે closely associated છે.
tip_en: Superfluidity → Bose-Einstein condensation.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The partition function of a single gas molecule is Z0. The partition function of N non-interacting identical gas molecules is:
question_gu: એક gas moleculeનું partition function Z0 હોય તો N non-interacting identical gas moleculesનું partition function શું છે?
explanation_en: For N non-interacting identical classical particles, the canonical partition function is Z=Z0^N/N! due to indistinguishability.
explanation_gu: N non-interacting identical classical particles માટે Z=Z0^N/N! થાય છે, કારણ કે particles indistinguishable છે.
tip_en: Identical classical particles → divide by N!.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The ratio Cp/Cv for a diatomic molecular gas:
question_gu: Diatomic molecular gas માટે Cp/Cv ratio:

options.B: increases continuously with increase in temperature
options.C: changes in steps at particular values of temperature
options.D: decreases continuously with increase in temperature

explanation_en: As additional rotational and vibrational degrees of freedom become thermally active at characteristic temperature ranges, Cp/Cv changes in steps in the idealized model.
explanation_gu: Temperature વધતાં rotational/vibrational degrees of freedom active થતાં Cp/Cv characteristic temperature ranges પર step-like change કરે છે.
tip_en: Degrees of freedom activate at characteristic temperatures.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: What should be the minimum number of bits required to convert analog voltage having full range of 0 to 2 volts to digital with a resolution of 4 mV?
question_gu: 0 થી 2 V full-range analog voltageને 4 mV resolution સાથે digitalમાં convert કરવા minimum કેટલા bits જોઈએ?
explanation_en: Number of quantization levels required is 2 V/0.004 V=500. We need 2^n≥500, so n=9 because 2^8=256 and 2^9=512.
tip_en: ADC bits: 2^n ≥ full-scale/resolution.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: In 8085 the number of maximum input and output devices that can be connected is:
question_gu: 8085માં maximum કેટલા input અને output devices connect કરી શકાય?
explanation_en: The 8085 provides an 8-bit I/O address space, allowing 256 I/O ports in principle; however, the official key for this source marks A. The source/key convention is retained and flagged for review if needed.
explanation_gu: 8085માં I/O addressingની standard interpretation 256 ports સુધીની છે, પરંતુ sourceની official key A આપે છે. તેથી source/key convention preserve કરવો જરૂરી છે.
review_note: Official key is preserved; standard 8085 I/O-port count can be interpreted as 256, so this item needs source/key review.
tip_en: Check whether the question refers to dedicated I/O address lines or devices/ports.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: For high efficiency optoelectronic devices the preferred semiconductor is:
question_gu: High-efficiency optoelectronic devices માટે preferred semiconductor કયો છે?
explanation_en: Direct band-gap semiconductors efficiently absorb and emit photons because electronic transitions can occur without phonon assistance. A narrow/appropriate direct band gap is preferred for many efficient optoelectronic devices.
explanation_gu: Direct band-gap semiconductorમાં photon emission/absorption efficiently થાય છે કારણ કે phonon assistance જરૂરી નથી. તેથી A.
tip_en: Efficient light emission → direct band gap.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The following circuit is known as:
question_gu: આપેલ circuitને શું કહે છે?
explanation_en: The capacitor is in series with the input and the resistor is in the feedback path of the inverting op-amp configuration. Since Z_in=1/(sC), Vout/Vin=−sRC, so it is a differentiator.
explanation_gu: Inputમાં capacitor અને feedbackમાં resistor હોવાથી Vout/Vin=−sRC થાય છે. તેથી circuit differentiator છે.
tip_en: Differentiator: capacitor at input, resistor in feedback.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: What is the output when number 59 is converted to hexadecimal?
question_gu: Decimal number 59ને hexadecimalમાં convert કરતાં output શું આવશે?
explanation_en: 59 decimal = 3×16+11. Thus the hexadecimal representation is 3B.
explanation_gu: 59=3×16+11, એટલે hexadecimal representation 3B છે.
tip_en: 59₁₀ = 3B₁₆.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Low resistance can be measured by:
question_gu: Low resistance માપવા માટે કયું instrument/bridge વપરાય છે?
explanation_en: Kelvin's double bridge is designed for accurate measurement of very low resistances while minimizing lead and contact resistance effects.
explanation_gu: Kelvin double bridge very low resistance માટે ઉપયોગી છે અને lead/contact resistanceની અસર ઘટાડે છે.
tip_en: Low resistance → Kelvin double bridge.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following pressure gauges is used for measuring pressure in the range of 10^−10 Torr?
question_gu: 10^−10 Torr rangeનું pressure માપવા કયું pressure gauge વપરાય છે?
explanation_en: Hot-cathode ionization gauges can measure ultra-high vacuum pressures down to around 10^−10 Torr, within suitable operating conditions.
explanation_gu: Hot-cathode ionization gauge ultra-high vacuum, આશરે 10^−10 Torr range, માટે વપરાય છે.
tip_en: Ultra-high vacuum → ionization/hot-cathode gauge.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: At low value of magnetic field the transverse magnetoresistance is:
question_gu: Low magnetic field પર transverse magnetoresistance કેવી રીતે vary થાય છે?

options.C: Proportional to the square of the field
options.D: Inversely proportional to the square of the field

explanation_en: In the low-field regime, ordinary transverse magnetoresistance is commonly quadratic in magnetic field: Δρ/ρ ∝ B².
explanation_gu: Low-field regimeમાં transverse magnetoresistance સામાન્ય રીતે B² સાથે proportional હોય છે: Δρ/ρ∝B².
tip_en: Low-field magnetoresistance → B² dependence.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A workshop superintendent measures temperature of a boiler. He will use:
question_gu: Workshop superintendent boilerનું temperature માપવા માટે શું વાપરશે?
explanation_en: A boiler can be measured remotely at high temperature using a radiation pyrometer, which determines temperature from thermal radiation.
explanation_gu: Boilerનું high temperature remote measurement radiation pyrometerથી કરી શકાય છે.
tip_en: High-temperature non-contact measurement → radiation pyrometer.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: For two resistances R1=100±0.1 Ω and R2=50±0.03 Ω find the value of equivalent resistance when they are connected in parallel:
question_gu: R1=100±0.1 Ω અને R2=50±0.03 Ω parallelમાં જોડાય ત્યારે equivalent resistance શોધો.
explanation_en: The nominal parallel resistance is R=R1R2/(R1+R2)=33.33 Ω. Propagating independent absolute uncertainties by first-order differentials gives an uncertainty of about 0.068 Ω for the stated values, matching D.
explanation_gu: Nominal R=R1R2/(R1+R2)=33.33 Ω. First-order error propagationથી uncertainty આશરે 0.068 Ω મળે છે, એટલે D.
tip_en: For parallel resistance, propagate uncertainty through partial derivatives.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Laser light is not:
question_gu: Laser light કયું નથી?
explanation_en: Laser light is coherent, highly directional and can be very intense. Therefore it is not non-coherent.
explanation_gu: Laser light coherent, directional અને intense હોય છે. તેથી non-coherent નથી.
tip_en: Laser properties: coherent, directional, intense.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Pauli's exclusion principle states that:
question_gu: Pauli exclusion principle શું કહે છે?

options.A: Two electrons cannot have all the quantum numbers same
options.B: Two electrons can have all the quantum numbers same
options.D: Particles with integer and half-integer spin cannot exist in the same state

explanation_en: No two identical fermions can occupy the same quantum state. For electrons, they cannot have all four quantum numbers identical.
explanation_gu: બે identical fermions same quantum stateમાં રહી શકતા નથી; electrons માટે ચારેય quantum numbers same હોઈ શકતા નથી.
tip_en: Pauli exclusion → no two identical fermions have identical complete quantum numbers.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The Bohr model gives the value for ionization potential of Li2+ ion as:
question_gu: Bohr model મુજબ Li²⁺ ionનું ionization potential કેટલું છે?
explanation_en: Li²⁺ is hydrogen-like with Z=3. The ground-state ionization energy is 13.6Z²=13.6×9=122.4 eV.
explanation_gu: Li²⁺ hydrogen-like ion છે અને Z=3. Ionization energy=13.6Z²=13.6×9=122.4 eV.
tip_en: Hydrogen-like ion: ionization energy = 13.6 Z² eV.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The normal Zeeman effect is:
question_gu: Normal Zeeman effect શું છે?

options.A: Not a confirmation of space quantization
options.B: Observed only in atoms with an even number of electrons
options.C: Observed only in atoms with an odd number of electrons

explanation_en: The normal Zeeman effect, with splitting into equally spaced components, is a manifestation of quantization of the magnetic quantum number and hence space quantization.
explanation_gu: Normal Zeeman splitting magnetic quantum numberની quantization અને space quantization સાથે જોડાયેલું છે. તેથી D.
tip_en: Normal Zeeman effect → space quantization.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Arrange energy differences involved in electronic transitions, vibrational transitions and rotational transitions in ascending order:
question_gu: Electronic, vibrational અને rotational transitionsમાં energy differencesને ascending orderમાં ગોઠવો.
topic: Atomic and Molecular Physics — Molecular spectra
explanation_en: Typical molecular energy scales satisfy rotational < vibrational < electronic. Therefore the ascending order is rotational, vibrational, electronic.
explanation_gu: સામાન્ય molecular spectraમાં rotational energy < vibrational energy < electronic energy. તેથી ascending order B છે.
tip_en: Energy scale: rotational < vibrational < electronic.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય formula/concept યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

explanation_en: An FCC lattice has coordination number 12.

question_en: Bragg's law in terms of reciprocal lattice vector G is:

question_en: For a superconductor, the Meissner effect demonstrates its:

question_en: Binding energy per nucleon for the nuclei ⁴He, ⁵⁶Fe, ¹⁹⁷Au and ²³⁵U are given as BE1, BE2, BE3 and BE4 respectively. Which order is correct?

question_en: The decay chain of the nucleus ²³⁸U involves eight α-decays and six β-decays. The final nucleus at the end of the process will have:
question_gu: ²³⁸U decay chainમાં 8 α-decays અને 6 β-decays થાય તો final nucleus શું હશે?
